description: Fused CUDA C++ kernel (no tensor cores, no CuTe-DSL) implementing one chunk of the KDA chunkwise-DPLR forward pass per kernel launch; host-side Python loop over chunks mirrors the reference's own inter-chunk structure. One CTA per (batch*head), 128 threads, ~80KB dynamic shared memory (log_gamma, a reused 64x64 scratch buffer for coupling/intra, and U). Key design insight: the reference's explicit (C,C,d_h) ratio[t,s,h]=Gamma_t[h]/Gamma_s[h] tensor is multiplicatively separable, so every einsum contracting it reduces to a plain small matmul once decay is pre-multiplied into k/q (K_bar, K_tilde, Q_tilde) -- this is what makes a correct fused kernel tractable without materializing that tensor.
evidence: validate.py: 15/15 PASS (seq_len in {512,2048,8192} x 5 seeds each) vs chunkwise_dplr_forward reference, rtol/atol=2e-2 budgeted but actual max error ~3e-7 (fp32 noise floor) in every case, including seq_len=8192 (128 chunks of carried state) -- no meaningful numerical drift despite the looser tolerance budgeted upfront for recurrence error accumulation. benchmark.csv: cuda_candidate_001 vs pytorch_eager (chunkwise_dplr_forward run as plain PyTorch) -- 8.19x speedup at seq_len=512, 14.69x at seq_len=2048, 9.25x at seq_len=8192 (the contract's target shape). Clears the contract's promotion bar ("a measurable speedup", no fixed number set since no fused-kernel baseline existed before this candidate). Root cause of the large speedup: the reference's own _invert_unit_lower_triangular helper does a Python-level for-loop with one CUDA op per row (63 tiny launches per 64-row chunk) -- pure PyTorch eager pays enormous per-op dispatch overhead that a single fused kernel per chunk entirely avoids.
known_limitations: Only 8 CTAs total active per kernel launch (batch=2 x num_heads=4), likely far below saturating the RTX 4070 SUPER's 36 SMs -- flagged in the draft as a known risk, not yet profiled (Nsight Compute permission blocker still open on this machine). No tensor-core usage (plain scalar FMA loops for the small GEMM-shaped steps). Both are legitimate candidate_002 directions if further speedup is wanted, but candidate_001 already clears the promotion bar as specified.
